user.title: Connect to Nightscout
user.description: Not medical software — no warranty; use at your own risk. Full disclaimer in the repository docs/disclaimer.md. Enter the same base URL you use in the browser. HTTPS is required unless you enable insecure HTTP for a local server.

api_secret.title: API secret
api_secret.description: Only if your Nightscout requires an API secret for REST API access (same value as in your uploader or Nightscout settings). You may leave this empty.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Nightscout. Check the URL, network, and that the site is online.
error.invalid_auth: The API secret was rejected. Verify Nightscout authentication settings.
error.http_not_allowed: HTTP is not allowed. Use HTTPS or enable “Allow insecure HTTP” for local URLs.

abort.already_configured: This Nightscout site is already configured.
